meta.name: Database access
meta.description: Request database roles on SQL Server, Oracle and PostgreSQL: approval, automated provisioning, time-bound access, access reviews and drift

portal.requestDescription: Get a role on a SQL Server, Oracle or PostgreSQL database for a limited time.

dbaccess-requester.name: Database access requester
dbaccess-requester.description: Request database roles and manage your own database access (granted to everyone by default)

dbaccess-dba.name: Database access administrator
dbaccess-dba.description: Configure servers and requestable roles, run inventory syncs, see all access, revoke, adopt unmanaged access and retry provisioning

dbaccess-auditor.name: Database access auditor
dbaccess-auditor.description: See all database access, accounts, drift and access reviews

dbaccess-review-manager.name: Database access review manager
dbaccess-review-manager.description: Run access review campaigns: start, follow up, close and export them

permissions.selfRequest: Request database roles and manage your own database access
permissions.serversManage: Configure servers and requestable roles, run inventory syncs
permissions.grantsRead: See all database access, accounts, unmanaged access and orphans
permissions.grantsManage: Revoke database access, adopt unmanaged access and retry provisioning
permissions.reviewsRead: See database access review campaigns and their reports

settings.retrySecondsHelp: Wait before the second attempt; each next attempt waits four times longer. After 3 attempts the grant fails and the server's DBA group is alerted.

request.name: Database access request
request.description: Approves a database role: the requester's manager, the role owner, and information security for high-risk roles

sync.name: Database access: inventory sync
sync.description: Reads the accounts, roles and memberships of a server and reports unmanaged access

request_approved.label: My database access requests are approved
request_approved.title: {reference} approved: {role}
request_approved.body: {extension, select, yes {Your access on {server} was extended.} other {Your access on {server} is being set up. We'll tell you when it's ready.}}

request_rejected.label: My database access requests are rejected
request_rejected.title: {reference} rejected: {role}
request_rejected.body: Your request for {role} on {server} was not approved. {comment}

grant_ready.label: My database access is ready
grant_ready.title: Your access is ready: {role}
grant_ready.body: Account {account} on {server} now has {role}{permanent, select, yes {.} other { until {expiresAt}.}} Open My database access to see the password once.

grant_expiring.label: My database access ends soon
grant_expiring.title: Your access to {role} ends soon
grant_expiring.body: Your access on {server} ends on {expiresAt}. Request an extension if you still need it.

grant_revoked.label: My database access was removed
grant_revoked.title: Access removed: {role}
grant_revoked.body: {reason, select, expired {Your access on {server} has ended.} review {Your access on {server} was removed after an access review.} other {Your access on {server} was revoked.}} {note}

provisioning_failed.label: Database provisioning failed (DBAs)
provisioning_failed.title: {operation, select, revoke {Revocation} other {Provisioning}} failed on {server}
provisioning_failed.body: {role} for {person} could not be {operation, select, revoke {revoked} other {granted}} after 3 attempts: {error}

review_assigned.label: Database access reviews assigned to me
review_assigned.title: Please review database access: {name}
review_assigned.body: {count, plural, one {# grant waits} other {# grants wait}} for your decision. Due on {dueOn}.

review_reminder.label: Database access review reminders
review_reminder.title: Reminder: {name} is due on {dueOn}
review_reminder.body: {pending, plural, one {# grant still waits} other {# grants still wait}} for your decision. Undecided access will be {policy, select, revoke {revoked} other {kept}}.

audit.review_decided: Decided database access in a review
audit.review_exported: Exported a database access review report

reveal.title: Your database password
reveal.description: The password was generated when your account was created. It is shown once and never sent by e-mail.
reveal.confirm: The password is shown only once, for 7 days after the account was created. Have your password manager ready, then show it.
reveal.onceWarning: Store it now in your password manager. It cannot be shown again; a DBA can reset it if you lose it.
reveal.expired: This password was already shown or has expired. Ask a DBA to reset it if you need it.

mine.title: My database access
mine.description: Database roles you hold, what you asked for, and your one-time passwords.
mine.pending: {count, plural, one {# request waiting for approval} other {# requests waiting for approval}}
mine.access: {count, plural, =0 {Your access} one {Your access (#)} other {Your access (#)}}
mine.empty: You have no database access yet
mine.emptyHint: Request a role on a database: your manager and the role owner approve it, and your account is set up automatically.
mine.failedHint: Setting up this access failed. The DBAs were alerted and will retry it.
mine.provisioningHint: Your account is being set up on the server. This takes a minute.
mine.relinquishDescription: The role is removed from your account right away. You can request it again later.

owned.title: Access to roles you own
owned.description: Who holds the database roles you or your group own. Select a row to see the details or revoke the access early.
owned.empty: Nobody holds your roles right now
owned.emptyHint: Access granted to your roles shows up here, and you can revoke it early.

wizard.title: Request database access
wizard.description: Choose the roles you need, say until when and why, and send it for approval.
wizard.extendDescription: Choose a new end date and say why you still need the access.
wizard.noRolesHint: Try another search, or ask the DBAs to make the role requestable.
wizard.selected: {count, plural, =0 {No roles selected} one {# role selected} other {# roles selected}}
wizard.justificationPlaceholder: For example: month-end reporting for the finance team.
wizard.justificationHint: The approvers read this. Mention the project, ticket or change if there is one.
wizard.afterApproval: Once approved, your account is created or updated automatically and you'll get a notification. A generated password is shown to you once.
wizard.sent: {count, plural, one {Request sent} other {# requests sent}}

errors.past: {role}: choose an end date in the future.
errors.tooLong: {role} can be granted for at most {days} days.
errors.justification: Say why you need this access (at least 10 characters).

requestPage.notFound: This request does not exist or you can't see it.

statusHint.approved: Approved. The access is set up automatically.

requestPage.noWorkflow: This request was decided without an approval workflow.
requestPage.pathHidden: The approval path is not available to you.

grant.title: Database access
grant.revokeDescription: The role is removed from {person}'s account right away. They are told why.

access.title: Access
access.description: Every database role granted through the platform, the accounts on each server, and access no grant explains.
access.emptyHint: Change the filters to see more.
access.unmanagedHint: Memberships of requestable roles found by the last sync that no grant explains. Adopt them for the right person with an end date, or revoke them.

accounts.emptyHint: Accounts appear after a server is synced.

unmanaged.title: Unmanaged access
unmanaged.emptyHint: Every membership of a requestable role is explained by a grant.
unmanaged.adoptDescription: Record this access as a grant for the right person, with an end date. It then expires, is reviewed and is revoked like any other access.
unmanaged.untilHint: Leave empty for no end date, if the role allows it.
unmanaged.revokeDescription: The role is removed from the account on the server. The account itself stays.

servers.title: Servers
servers.description: Database servers whose accounts and roles the platform manages, with their last sync and drift.
servers.emptyHint: Choose an admin connection below to manage accounts on it.
servers.unconfiguredHint: Administrators register connections with the admin purpose in Database connections. Manage accounts on one to make its roles requestable.

serverForm.createDescription: Settings for {connection}. Sync it afterwards to pick requestable roles.
serverForm.editDescription: New accounts follow these settings; existing accounts keep their names.

pattern.label: Account name pattern
pattern.preview: Your account would be {name}. Tokens: '{username}' and '{email_local}'.
pattern.invalid: Only letters, digits, _ and the tokens.
pattern.no_token: Include a token so every person gets their own account.

serverForm.passwordHint: Between {min} and {max} characters (Oracle uses at most 30).
serverForm.externalHint: Accounts authenticate against the server's external directory (LDAP, Kerberos or Microsoft Entra ID): no password is generated.
serverForm.ownerGroupHint: Alerted when provisioning fails on this server.

server.rolesHint: Roles people can request on this server, with their owner (the approver), risk and durations.
server.noRolesHint: Pick roles from the synced inventory.
server.syncFirst: Sync the server first: requestable roles come from its inventory.
server.inventoryHint: Roles and their members as of the last sync.

roleForm.description: People can request it from the portal. The owner approves requests after the requester's manager; high-risk roles also need information security.
roleForm.roleHint: Only roles from the last sync can be chosen.
roleForm.name: Display name
roleForm.riskHint: High-risk roles also need information security's approval.
roleForm.roleRequired: Choose a role from the inventory.

problems.max_required: Set a maximum, or allow permanent access.
problems.default_over_max: The default cannot be longer than the maximum.

reviews.title: Access reviews
reviews.description: Campaigns where role owners or managers confirm who still needs database access.
reviews.awaitingCount: {count, plural, one {# grant} other {# grants}} to decide · due {due}
reviews.name: Campaign
reviews.emptyHint: Campaigns you take part in appear here.
reviews.emptyHintManager: Start a campaign to have owners confirm who still needs access.

reviewForm.title: New access review
reviewForm.description: Active grants in scope are snapshotted when the campaign starts and assigned to reviewers.
reviewForm.name: Name
reviewForm.dueAfterStart: The due date must be after the start.

review.notFound: This access review does not exist or you can't see it.
review.closeDescription: {pending, plural, =0 {Every grant was decided.} one {# grant is undecided.} other {# grants are undecided.}} Undecided access follows the policy: {policy}. Revocations start right away and the campaign becomes read-only.
review.readOnly: This campaign is closed: decisions can no longer change.
review.revokeTitle: {count, plural, one {Revoke this access?} other {Revoke # grants?}}
review.revokeDescription: Say why. The access is removed when the campaign closes.
review.decided: {count, plural, one {Decision saved} other {# decisions saved}}

taskConfig.hint: Reads accounts, roles and memberships, and reports unmanaged access.

dashboard.description: {reviews, plural, =0 {} one {# review awaits you.} other {# reviews await you.}} {expiring, plural, =0 {} one {# grant ends soon.} other {# grants end soon.}}
